consumer: The engine's own possession check on the avatar -- visitable<Character>::amount_of / has_amount(multitool) -- which EVALUATES the yes/no 'does the avatar possess at least one working multitool?'
scope: only the character's own carried items (wielded/worn/inventory and pseudo/bionic tool possessions), not nearby or reachable items
decisive_source: src/visitable.cpp::visitable<Character>::amount_of -- tallies how many of the itype the Character has, special-casing pseudo/bionic fake tools, returning the engine-computed possession count that a yes/no check consumes
divergence: The avatar has the multitool only as an active bionic/pseudo fake-tool (no real item in carried_items[]): amount_of(...,pseudo=true) returns 1 via the BIONIC_TOOLS special-case while a re-derivation that scans avatar.carried_items[] from write_carried_items finds nothing and wrongly answers 'no'
